finding.title: Oversized raw goal evidence is treated as an ordinary rejected term, so later goal stages continue
finding.trigger: A check result whose canonical raw evidence exceeds the per-file 8 MiB bound makes store_goal_evidence raise ValueError. Worker main converts that into a small status=rejected / exit-2 response. Parent _admit_check only stops recognized resource codes or an oversized returned envelope; this small rejection passes, _check_goal returns True with the goal unresolved, and _check continues to later supplied goals. This violates 599’s explicit stop-later-stages behavior for raw evidence capacity exhaustion.
finding.reproduction: Pure API reproduction passed checked={status:rejected, diagnostic.code:worker-rejected, diagnostic.message:"raw goal evidence exceeds 8 MiB", result:null} to _admit_check; observed True, no output-limit diagnostic, and goal unresolved. Worker source establishes this exact rejection envelope for the storage ValueError. No Lean.

otherReview: Storage path is fixed under .ladon/contract-obligations and content-bound; exclusive write/existing-byte equality, symlink checks, regular-file bounded read, digest/byte-count verification and exact-projection check were inspected. Route input/context and endpoint source/prose freshness guards remain before/after term checking. No separate issue found in those reviewed areas.
